# Roadrunner

Roadrunner (RRTS) is a Truck Transportation company. Roadrunner employs 866 people (+9.2% YoY, +73 people) and has an annual revenue of $1.8B, founded in 1984. Headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, United States, with an office in Cudahy. Its workforce is distributed across 7 countries (including United States, Canada, Colombia, Belgium, and France).

## About

Roadrunner is for ambitious, smart people who excel at execution over talking about it, and who would rather invent the next standard in freight than accept the current one.

We are looking for the Best of the Best. Action driven leaders who want to be part of real change and help design the future of LTL in the U.S. 

This is a place where high performers can grow, influence outcomes, and make an impact while working directly with executives and smart people from across industries. Marketing, pricing, technology, accounting, operations: every function has room to lead and leave a mark.

We bring a winner mindset. We take ownership, raise the bar, and measure ourselves by results. We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together. These principles create an environment of high standards, clear ownership, and direct collaboration. We trust data over tradition, move with urgency, and hold each other accountable because winning requires it.

Roadrunner exists to prove that LTL can be better than the industry has settled for. Most carriers still run on old assumptions: too many handoffs, limited visibility, and the quiet belief that “this is just how it works.” We rejected that story. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ for direct, long haul, metro to metro service that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real time visibility, and genuine accountability. We are the most tech forward company in LTL, and we are not finished widening the gap.
The foundation is already strong. Recognized as one of Built In Chicago’s Best Large Places to Work. Earning top marks for improvement, quality, and service. The real opportunity is still ahead: helping invent what comes next.

If you want to be evaluated among the Best of the Best and help set the new standard in LTL, we should talk.
